Transport Modes

Camion Pianale

A commercial vehicle with a flat, open cargo bed, used for transporting oversized or non-containerized goods; referenced in waybills, CMR consignment notes, and cargo manifests for breakbulk or project cargo.

Quick answer: A commercial vehicle with a flat, open cargo bed, used for transporting oversized or non-containerized goods; referenced in waybills, CMR consignment notes, and cargo manifests for breakbulk or project cargo.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Camion Pianale?

In this glossary, Camion Pianale refers to: A commercial vehicle with a flat, open cargo bed, used for transporting oversized or non-containerized goods; referenced in waybills, CMR consignment notes, and cargo manifests for breakbulk or project cargo.

How is Camion Pianale used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Un camion pianale è stato noleggiato per trasportare travi d’acciaio per un progetto edile come da lettera di vettura CMR."

Why does Camion Pianale matter in logistics?

Camion Pianale matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Camion Pianale?

Camion Pianale is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A commercial vehicle with a flat, open cargo bed, used for transporting oversized or non-containerized goods; referenced in waybills, CMR consignment notes, and cargo manifests for breakbulk or project cargo.

Operational example

A flatbed truck was contracted to move steel beams for a construction project, as documented in the CMR waybill.
